stages.headline: A prism has two equal polygonal faces (bases) in parallel planes and parallelograms as its other (lateral) faces.
stages.headlineEnglish: A prism has two equal polygonal faces (bases) in parallel planes and parallelograms as its other (lateral) faces.

stages.headline: A parallelepiped has six faces, all parallelograms; it has 8 vertices, 12 edges and 6 faces.
stages.headlineEnglish: A parallelepiped has six faces, all parallelograms; it has 8 vertices, 12 edges and 6 faces.

stages.headline: In a rectangular box (all faces rectangles) the diagonal satisfies d² = a² + b² + c²; e.g. 2, 3, 6 ⇒ d = 7.
